name: Delivery Breakout v5 (asymmetric exit, tight stop)
description: delivery_breakout_v3 with an asymmetric exit grid: tighter stop (4%) and wider target (14%) with a longer hold (12 days). Favourable R:R of 3.5:1 vs v3's 2:1. Tests whether letting the delivery-confirmed breakouts run further improves expectancy without materially worsening drawdown (program.md #12 triple-barrier exit search). One-variable (exit) change vs v3.
